correctness.rationale: Monomial norms are n! except the mth norm m!(1+tau m!), so the kernel exactly equals e^t-qt^m. For r<=R, |e^t-qt^m|>=e^{-|t|}-q|t|^m>=e^{-r}-qr^m; t=-r attains equality only because m is even. For r>=R, t=-R is a contained zero; at the nearest-zero radius equality in Re(t)>=-|t| forces t negative real and uniqueness. Derivative at -R is e^{-R}+qmR^(m-1)>0. Stirling and W derivative yield stated correction. Independent calculations used 12 (m,tau) parameter pairs with 640 sampled complex tests each plus exact R relation.
